design: Prespecified 2x2 context x weighting factorial at seeds17/29; checkpoint choice uses unweighted VAL NLL, policy uses CAL only; audit selects no TEST winner

context_availability.missing_run_definition: Consecutive missing-X roots inside physical support, bounded at physical/date/cadence reset. Occupancy is positions times 5s; first-to-last timestamp span is (positions-1) times 5s. These are absent observations, not physical support gaps.
context_availability.definition: On known admitted evaluation roots, RF61 counts actual supported 5s clock positions. Missing X positions are present in restored context but have zero values/masks. Observed-token fraction divides admitted X positions by supported clock positions; observed/RF also includes padding in its denominator. Unknown Y never resets context.
context_availability.physical_definition: Saved full-publication quote token includes invalid, epoch and >60s gap transitions, even between two individually available origins. Day/cadence reset is counted separately from same-day physical boundary pairs.
context_availability.source_only_definition: A same-day regular pair reset by legacy but not by restored support. This is a known observation/admission-only history reset, not a missing physical quote event.

identity_overlap.caveat: Saved crossing IDs may share market paths. Unique IDs and multiplicity are not counts of statistically independent events.

uniform.ESS_definition: Kish (sum weights)^2/sum squared weights, a weight-concentration diagnostic; not an independent-event count or time-series effective sample size

crossing_id.ESS_definition: Kish (sum weights)^2/sum squared weights, a weight-concentration diagnostic; not an independent-event count or time-series effective sample size

evidence.interpretation: Exact saved-data/source parity and causal metadata verification on three declared days. This is not an economic or uninspected-holdout claim.
evidence.method: V2 full-day targets/execution/features replay; independently calculated publication/asof/admission and full raw quote support tokens; no V3 wrapper called; only COMPLETE days read.

factorial.sign: Positive means lower NLL/Brier or higher event AUC. Main effects average the two settings of the other factor. Interaction=(restored crossing_id-restored uniform)-(legacy crossing_id-legacy uniform) on utility, where utility=-loss or +AUC.
factorial.intervals: Descriptive equal-day paired percentile bootstrap. Same dates are resampled for all arms. Seed-mean intervals average seeds within each date before resampling; the same day is never counted as two independent days. No multiple-comparison or independent-day claim.
factorial.selection: All eight prespecified arms are reported; no TEST winner selection

event_balanced_definition: Among known feature-available positive side memberships, group by (LONG or SHORT, first qualifying ID). First average each score across that group's roots, then average groups equally. BOTH supplies two memberships. Overall denominator is distinct side-ID groups, not roots or raw ID alone. NEGATIVE roots are excluded; this cannot measure false positives, full-population calibration, or economic edge. Uniform-root metrics remain primary.
limitations: Kish weight ESS quantifies weight concentration, not independent financial observations.
Class-normalized inverse multiplicity preserves joint-class mass but does not exactly equalize crossing IDs.
Day intervals are descriptive; adjacent days and shared market events are dependent, and dates were historically exposed.
Context, training weights, BCE/CE derivatives, crossing outcomes, and after-cost policy returns are separate claims.
